quote: The dietary lead levels to which Prussian carp was exposed in the present experiment were based on the reported concentrations of this metal in benthic organisms that are the Prussian carp’s natural food, which may range from 0 to as much as 792 μg Pb g −1 dry weight (dw) (Hodson et al. 1978 ; Woodward et al. 1994).
statement: 本实验中普鲁士鲤鱼暴露的膳食铅水平基于其天然食物底栖生物中该金属的报告浓度，范围可从0至高达792 μg Pb g−1干重。
text_zh: 本实验中普鲁士鲤鱼暴露的膳食铅水平基于其天然食物底栖生物中该金属的报告浓度，范围可从0至高达792 μg Pb g−1干重。
text_en: In this experiment, the dietary lead levels to which Prussian carp were exposed were based on reported concentrations of this metal in their natural food, benthic organisms, ranging from 0 to as high as 792 μg Pb g−1 dry weight.

quote: Given that the study was aimed to show the effect of long-term exposure (the normal level of lead in invertebrates in an unpolluted environment should not exceed 1 μg g −1 (Farag et al. 1999), we chose concentrations simulating the average degree of environmental contamination (8, 13, 24, and 49 mg kg −1) to find out if their constant presence in fish diets will significantly affect some reproductive parameters as well as the bioaccumulation and subsequent elimination of lead from Prussian carp gonads.
statement: 研究旨在展示长期暴露的影响，选择了模拟平均环境污染程度的浓度（8、13、24和49 mg kg−1），以确定其在鱼类饮食中的持续存在是否会显著影响某些生殖参数以及铅在普鲁士鲤鱼性腺中的生物积累和随后的消除。
text_zh: 研究旨在展示长期暴露的影响，选择了模拟平均环境污染程度的浓度（8、13、24和49 mg kg−1），以确定其在鱼类饮食中的持续存在是否会显著影响某些生殖参数以及铅在普鲁士鲤鱼性腺中的生物积累和随后的消除。
text_en: The study aimed to demonstrate the effects of long-term exposure, selecting concentrations that simulate average environmental pollution levels (8, 13, 24 and 49 mg kg−1), to determine whether their persistence in fish diets would significantly affect certain reproductive parameters as well as the bioaccumulation and subsequent elimination of lead in the gonads of Prussian carp.
outcome: 生殖参数及污染物积累与消除

quote: During chronic a 24-month period exposure to Pb, Prussian carp female appears to acclimate to Pb doses used in the experiment.
statement: 在为期24个月的慢性铅暴露期间，雌性普鲁士鲤鱼似乎适应了实验中使用的铅剂量。
text_zh: 在为期24个月的慢性铅暴露期间，雌性普鲁士鲤鱼似乎适应了实验中使用的铅剂量。
text_en: During the 24-month chronic lead exposure period, female Prussian carp appeared to adapt to the lead doses used in the experiment.

quote: At 3, 6, 12, 15, 18, and 24 months of the experiment, gonad samples were collected from 8 to 10 randomly harvested fish from each group.
statement: 在实验的第3、6、12、15、18和24个月，从每组随机捕捞8至10条鱼以采集性腺样本。
text_zh: 在实验的第3、6、12、15、18和24个月，从每组随机捕捞8至10条鱼以采集性腺样本。
text_en: At months 3, 6, 12, 15, 18 and 24 of the experiment, 8 to 10 fish were randomly harvested from each group to collect gonad samples.
outcome: 采样操作对个体的影响

text_en: Metode infestasi buatan melibatkan penempatan satu ekor ikan dan lima ekor Argulus japonicus dalam gelas kimia berisi 400 ml air selama 15 menit.

quote: In order to examine whether the consequences of 12-month lead exposure are reversible, in some of the fish, the exposure was terminated and for the next 12 months, they were subjected to depuration and received control feed.
statement: 为了检查12个月铅暴露的后果是否可逆，在一些鱼中终止了暴露，在接下来的12个月里，它们接受了净化处理并食用对照饲料。
text_zh: 为了检查12个月铅暴露的后果是否可逆，在一些鱼中终止了暴露，在接下来的12个月里，它们接受了净化处理并食用对照饲料。
text_en: To check whether the consequences of 12 months of lead exposure were reversible, exposure was terminated in some fish, and for the next 12 months they underwent depuration and were fed control feed.

quote: Also, deleterious effects of mercury on gonad’s growth, fish spawning, and egg production and development, fertilization, and hatching were observed (Birge et al. 1979 ; Snarski and Olson 1982 ; Ram and Sathyanesan 1983 ; Ram and Joy 1988 ; Kirubagaran and Joy 1992 ; Crump and Trudeau 2009).

text_zh: 汞对鱼类性腺生长、产卵、卵子产生与发育、受精及孵化具有有害影响。
text_en: Mercury has harmful effects on fish gonad growth, spawning, egg production and development, fertilization, and hatching.

quote: The toxic effect of lead on gametes was shown in studies with both male and female animals (Goyer 1986).
statement: 铅对雄性和雌性动物配子的毒性作用已在研究中得到证实。
text_zh: 铅对雄性和雌性动物配子的毒性作用已在研究中得到证实。
text_en: The toxic effects of lead on gametes in male and female animals have been confirmed in studies.

quote: Prior to all the manipulations, fish were anesthetized with Propiscin (0.3 ml/l; IRS, Zabieniec, Poland).

text_en: Fish were anesthetized with Propiscin before all handling procedures.

quote: Fish were stocked in 14 300-l aquaria (30 fish per aquarium) in water supplied from the Municipal Waterworks in Cracow (average temperature of 17 °C, pH 7.7, dissolved oxygen of 10.5 mg l −1 , water hardness of 127 mg CaCO 3 l −1).
statement: Ryby trzymano w 14 akwariach o pojemności 300 litrów (30 ryb na akwarium) w wodzie z Miejskiego Przedsiębiorstwa Wodociągów i Kanalizacji w Krakowie, przy średniej temperaturze 17°C, pH 7,7, stężeniu rozpuszczonego tlenu 10,5 mg/l i twardości wody 127 mg CaCO3/l.
text_en: Ryby trzymano w 14 akwariach o pojemności 300 litrów (30 ryb na akwarium) w wodzie z Miejskiego Przedsiębiorstwa Wodociągów i Kanalizacji w Krakowie, przy średniej temperaturze 17°C, pH 7,7, stężeniu rozpuszczonego tlenu 10,5 mg/l i twardości wody 127 mg CaCO3/l.
outcome: Warunki środowiskowe (gęstość obsady, temperatura, pH, tlen, twardość)

quote: In addition, the water was aerated and filtered.
statement: Dodatkowo woda była napowietrzana i filtrowana.
text_en: Dodatkowo woda była napowietrzana i filtrowana.

quote: Fish were divided into five groups which were fed control pellets (control group) and pellets contaminated with different concentrations of lead (8, 13, 24, and 49 mg Pb kg −1) for two exposure periods of 12 and 24 months.
statement: Ryby podzielono na pięć grup, które karmiono peletami kontrolnymi (grupa kontrolna) oraz peletami skażonymi różnymi stężeniami ołowiu (8, 13, 24 i 49 mg Pb/kg) przez dwa okresy ekspozycji wynoszące 12 i 24 miesiące.
text_en: Ryby podzielono na pięć grup, które karmiono peletami kontrolnymi (grupa kontrolna) oraz peletami skażonymi różnymi stężeniami ołowiu (8, 13, 24 i 49 mg Pb/kg) przez dwa okresy ekspozycji wynoszące 12 i 24 miesiące.

quote: Throughout the study, fish were fed once daily a ration that amounted to 3 % of their body weight.
statement: 在整个研究期间，鱼每天喂食一次，投喂量为体重的3%。
text_zh: 在整个研究期间，鱼每天喂食一次，投喂量为体重的3%。
text_en: Throughout the study period, fish were fed once daily at a rate of 3% of body weight.

quote: The mean body weight after the 12 months of exposure ranged from 27.1 ± 4 g of fish in group 3 exposed to 13 mg Pb kg −1 for 12 months to 40.4 g in the control group.
statement: 暴露12个月后，平均体重从暴露于13 mg Pb/kg 12个月的第3组鱼的27.1 ± 4 g到对照组的40.4 g不等。
text_zh: 暴露12个月后，平均体重从暴露于13 mg Pb/kg 12个月的第3组鱼的27.1 ± 4 g到对照组的40.4 g不等。
text_en: After 12 months of exposure, the mean body weight ranged from 27.1 ± 4 g in Group 3 fish exposed to 13 mg Pb/kg for 12 months to 40.4 g in the control group.

quote: During a long-term exposure to low doses of metals, fish may show no noticeable reaction in terms of growth or survival parameters, but chronic contamination may adversely affect their reproductive organs, leading to reduced reproductive parameters and disappearance of the population (Kime 1995).
statement: 在长期暴露于低剂量金属期间，鱼类可能在生长或存活参数上没有明显反应，但慢性污染可能对其生殖器官产生不利影响，导致生殖参数降低和种群消失。
text_zh: 在长期暴露于低剂量金属期间，鱼类可能在生长或存活参数上没有明显反应，但慢性污染可能对其生殖器官产生不利影响，导致生殖参数降低和种群消失。
text_en: During long-term exposure to low doses of metals, fish may show no significant response in growth or survival parameters, but chronic contamination may adversely affect their reproductive organs, leading to reduced reproductive parameters and population disappearance.
outcome: 生殖器官健康与种群存续

quote: Kidd et al. (2007) observed that a chronic exposure of fathead minnow (Pimephales promelas) to low concentrations of the potent 17α-ethynylestradiol led to feminization of males and ultimately caused a near extinction of this species from the lake.
statement: Kidd等人（2007）观察到，黑头呆鱼长期暴露于低浓度的强效17α-乙炔雌二醇导致雄性雌性化，并最终导致该物种在湖泊中几乎灭绝。
text_zh: Kidd等人（2007）观察到，黑头呆鱼长期暴露于低浓度的强效17α-乙炔雌二醇导致雄性雌性化，并最终导致该物种在湖泊中几乎灭绝。
text_en: Kidd et al. (2007) observed that long-term exposure of fathead minnows to low concentrations of the potent 17α-ethinylestradiol caused masculinization of males, ultimately leading to near-extinction of the species in lakes.

quote: Earlier studies by other authors reported pituitary damage, nuclear degeneration, or reduced hatching rates as a result of exposure to heavy metals (Fernicola et al. 1985 ; Popek et al. 2006).
statement: 早期研究报道了重金属暴露导致的垂体损伤、核退化或孵化率降低。
text_zh: 早期研究报道了重金属暴露导致的垂体损伤、核退化或孵化率降低。
text_en: Early studies reported pituitary damage, nuclear degeneration, or reduced hatching rates caused by heavy metal exposure.
outcome: 生理损伤与繁殖成功率

quote: Significant negative correlation between GSI values and Pb concentration in gonad’s tissue was noted after a 12-month period (r = −0.58; p r = −0.49; p 2).
statement: 在12个月后，性腺组织中的铅浓度与性腺指数（GSI）值之间存在显著的负相关关系。
text_zh: 在12个月后，性腺组织中的铅浓度与性腺指数（GSI）值之间存在显著的负相关关系。
text_en: After 12 months, there was a significant negative correlation between lead concentration in gonad tissue and gonadosomatic index (GSI) values.
outcome: 生殖健康指标（性腺指数）

quote: As regards hormonally-stimulated LH secretion, LH concentration at 24 h postinjection was significantly (p −1 groups compared to the control group and the other groups (Fig. 4a) (Table 3).
statement: 关于激素刺激的LH分泌，注射后24小时的LH浓度在某些铅暴露组中与对照组及其他组相比存在显著差异。
text_zh: 关于激素刺激的LH分泌，注射后24小时的LH浓度在某些铅暴露组中与对照组及其他组相比存在显著差异。
text_en: Regarding hormone-stimulated LH secretion, LH concentrations at 24 hours post-injection showed significant differences in certain lead exposure groups compared to the control group and other groups.

quote: we exposed female Prussian carp to artificial feed, supplemented with five doses of dietary Pb (0, 1 (control), 8, 13, 24, and 49 mg/kg) over either a 24-month period or a 12-month period, followed by further 12 months where the fish were fed the control diet.
statement: 实验将雌性银鲫暴露于补充了五种剂量膳食铅（0、1（对照）、8、13、24和49 mg/kg）的人工饲料中，持续24个月或12个月，随后再喂食对照饲料12个月。
text_zh: 实验将雌性银鲫暴露于补充了五种剂量膳食铅（0、1（对照）、8、13、24和49 mg/kg）的人工饲料中，持续24个月或12个月，随后再喂食对照饲料12个月。
text_en: The experiment exposed female silver crucian carp to artificial feed supplemented with five doses of dietary lead (0, 1 (control), 8, 13, 24 and 49 mg/kg) for 24 months or 12 months, followed by feeding control feed for 12 months.

quote: A significant increase in Pb concentration was already noticed after 3 months of exposure relative to baseline values in all the experimental groups (Fig. 5), as confirmed by statistically significant coefficients of correlation (Table 4).
statement: 在所有实验组中，相对于基线值，暴露3个月后卵巢组织中的铅浓度已显著增加。
text_zh: 在所有实验组中，相对于基线值，暴露3个月后卵巢组织中的铅浓度已显著增加。
text_en: In all experimental groups, lead concentrations in ovarian tissue increased significantly after 3 months of exposure relative to baseline values.

quote: Pb concentration reached maximum levels after 6 and 12 months of exposure, decreased after 15 months of exposure, and again peaked from 18 months of exposure until the end of the study (Fig. 5).
statement: 铅浓度在暴露6和12个月后达到最高水平，在15个月后下降，并从18个月直到研究结束再次达到峰值。
text_zh: 铅浓度在暴露6和12个月后达到最高水平，在15个月后下降，并从18个月直到研究结束再次达到峰值。
text_en: Lead concentrations reached the highest levels after 6 and 12 months of exposure, decreased after 15 months, and peaked again from 18 months until the end of the study.

quote: Lead has been found to affect various neurotransmitter systems in fish, including serotonergic (Spieler et al. 1995 ; Rademacher et al. 2003 ; Sloman et al. 2005), dopaminergic (Spieler et al. 1995 ; Rademacher et al. 2001), and noradrenergic (Spieler et al. 1995) pathways.
statement: 已发现铅会影响鱼类中的各种神经递质系统，包括血清素能、多巴胺能和去甲肾上腺素能通路。
text_zh: 已发现铅会影响鱼类中的各种神经递质系统，包括血清素能、多巴胺能和去甲肾上腺素能通路。
text_en: Lead has been found to affect various neurotransmitter systems in fish, including serotonergic, dopaminergic and noradrenergic pathways.

quote: Younger fish exhibit significantly lower antibody levels indicating that juvenile fish may not be able to mount an effective immune response as young adult fish (Hrubec et al. 2004).
statement: 较年轻的鱼表现出显著较低的抗体水平，表明幼鱼可能无法像年轻成鱼那样产生有效的免疫反应。
text_zh: 较年轻的鱼表现出显著较低的抗体水平，表明幼鱼可能无法像年轻成鱼那样产生有效的免疫反应。
text_en: Younger fish showed significantly lower antibody levels, indicating that juvenile fish may not be able to mount an effective immune response like young adult fish.

quote: It may be that older fish, which completed maturation and have developed their defense mechanisms, cope better with the negative effects of environmental lead.
statement: 完成成熟并发展出防御机制的老年鱼可能更好地应对环境铅的负面影响。
text_zh: 完成成熟并发展出防御机制的老年鱼可能更好地应对环境铅的负面影响。
text_en: Old fish that have reached maturity and developed defense mechanisms may better cope with the negative effects of environmental lead.

quote: Analyzing the relationship of oocyte diameter and Pb concentration in gonads, we can observe statistically significant correlation r = 0.72 (p 2).
statement: 分析性腺中卵母细胞直径与铅浓度的关系，观察到统计上显著的相关性r=0.72。
text_zh: 分析性腺中卵母细胞直径与铅浓度的关系，观察到统计上显著的相关性r=0.72。
text_en: Analysis of the relationship between oocyte diameter in gonads and lead concentration observed a statistically significant correlation r=0.72.
outcome: 生殖健康/卵母细胞发育

quote: Different results during 12 days of exposure to lead were reported by Ruby et al. (2000), who observed larger egg diameters in control fish compared to female fish exposed to lead at a dose of 10 μg/L.
statement: Ruby等人(2000)报道了铅暴露12天期间的不同结果，他们观察到对照鱼的卵径比暴露于10 μg/L剂量的雌鱼更大。
text_zh: Ruby等人(2000)报道了铅暴露12天期间的不同结果，他们观察到对照鱼的卵径比暴露于10 μg/L剂量的雌鱼更大。
text_en: Ruby et al. (2000) reported different results during a 12-day lead exposure period, observing that the egg diameter of control fish was larger than that of females exposed to a dose of 10 μg/L.

quote: Lead elicited biphasic effects on estradiol-17β, testosterone, and cortisol: stimulatory at lower concentrations and inhibitory at higher concentrations.
statement: 铅对雌二醇-17β、睾酮和皮质醇产生双相效应：低浓度时具有刺激作用，高浓度时具有抑制作用。
text_zh: 铅对雌二醇-17β、睾酮和皮质醇产生双相效应：低浓度时具有刺激作用，高浓度时具有抑制作用。
text_en: Lead has a biphasic effect on estradiol-17β, testosterone, and cortisol: it is stimulatory at low concentrations and inhibitory at high concentrations.

quote: We have studied the effect of Lactobacillus сasei probiotic microor-ganisms introduced into the feed on some individual hematological indicators of Carassius gibelio Bloch and analyzed changes in general behavioral indicators under the influence of modified feed.
statement: 作者研究了饲料中添加干酪乳杆菌益生菌对鲫鱼血液学指标和一般行为指标的影响。
text_zh: 作者研究了饲料中添加干酪乳杆菌益生菌对鲫鱼血液学指标和一般行为指标的影响。
text_en: The authors studied the effects of adding Lactobacillus casei probiotic microorganisms to feed on hematological indicators and general behavioral indicators of crucian carp.
outcome: 血液学指标与行为指标

quote: It has been proven that the introduction of probiotics as part of the feed substrate for 28 days has a positive effect on rapid adaptation to external stress factors, stabilization and weight gain of fish, physiological state of external mu-cous membranes, behavior and general condition of fish
statement: 在饲料基质中引入益生菌28天被证明对快速适应外部应激因素、鱼类稳定及增重、外部黏膜生理状态、行为及总体状况有积极影响。
text_zh: 在饲料基质中引入益生菌28天被证明对快速适应外部应激因素、鱼类稳定及增重、外部黏膜生理状态、行为及总体状况有积极影响。
text_en: The introduction of probiotics into the feed substrate for 28 days was shown to have positive effects on rapid adaptation to external stressors, fish stability and weight gain, external mucosal physiological state, behavior, and overall condition.
outcome: 应激适应、生长、黏膜健康、行为及总体状况

quote: An increase in the number of leukocytes, an in-crease in the level of phagocytic activity of neutrophils, in particular the phagocytic index, was noted, which confirms the direct effect of probiotics in increasing the body's reactivity.
statement: 观察到白细胞数量增加以及中性粒细胞吞噬活性水平（特别是吞噬指数）升高，这证实了益生菌在提高机体反应性方面的直接作用。
text_zh: 观察到白细胞数量增加以及中性粒细胞吞噬活性水平（特别是吞噬指数）升高，这证实了益生菌在提高机体反应性方面的直接作用。
text_en: An increase in white blood cell count and elevated neutrophil phagocytic activity levels (particularly the phagocytic index) were observed, confirming the direct effect of probiotics in enhancing host responsiveness.

quote: The beneficial effect of probiotics is associated with colonization resistance, biotransformation of toxins, regulatory and digestive functions.
statement: 益生菌的有益效果与定植抗性、毒素生物转化、调节和消化功能有关。
text_zh: 益生菌的有益效果与定植抗性、毒素生物转化、调节和消化功能有关。
text_en: The beneficial effects of probiotics are related to colonization resistance, toxin biotransformation, regulation and digestive functions.

quote: Chronic exposure to lead is not without an influence on the reproductive system of female Prussian carp.
statement: 慢性铅暴露对普鲁士鲤雌鱼的生殖系统并非没有影响。
text_zh: 慢性铅暴露对普鲁士鲤雌鱼的生殖系统并非没有影响。
text_en: Chronic lead exposure is not without effect on the reproductive system of female Prussian carp.

quote: The lead was accumulated in the ovary from the beginning of the exposure because already after 3 months, the level of Pb was observed to increase significantly in all the groups, even in that with the lowest exposure dose of 8-mg-Pb-kg −1 feed (Fig. 5).
statement: 铅在暴露开始后即在卵巢中积累，即使在最低剂量（8 mg/kg饲料）组中，3个月后铅水平也显著增加。
text_zh: 铅在暴露开始后即在卵巢中积累，即使在最低剂量（8 mg/kg饲料）组中，3个月后铅水平也显著增加。
text_en: Lead accumulated in the ovary immediately after the start of exposure, and lead levels increased significantly even in the lowest dose group (8 mg/kg feed) after 3 months.

quote: The level of lead accumulation in the ovary after 6 months of exposure did not change significantly compared to 12, 18, and 24 months, when the highest levels of lead were observed (Fig. 5), which suggests that after 6 months the analyzed tissue became saturated with lead; the concentration of which remained unchanged despite continued exposure.
statement: 暴露6个月后卵巢中的铅积累水平与12、18和24个月相比没有显著变化，表明该组织在6个月后已饱和，尽管继续暴露浓度仍保持不变。
text_zh: 暴露6个月后卵巢中的铅积累水平与12、18和24个月相比没有显著变化，表明该组织在6个月后已饱和，尽管继续暴露浓度仍保持不变。
text_en: After 6 months of exposure, lead accumulation levels in the ovary showed no significant change compared to 12, 18, and 24 months, indicating that the tissue had saturated after 6 months, although the continued exposure concentration remained unchanged.

quote: Toxic chemicals released into surface water may influence the growth and reproduction of aquatic organisms, especially fish (Szczerbik et al. 2006 ; Okorie et al. 2014).
statement: 释放到地表水中的有毒化学物质可能会影响水生生物（尤其是鱼类）的生长和繁殖。
text_zh: 释放到地表水中的有毒化学物质可能会影响水生生物（尤其是鱼类）的生长和繁殖。
text_en: Toxic chemicals released into surface water may affect the growth and reproduction of aquatic organisms (especially fish).

quote: According to experimental data, the use of probiotic-containing feed caused an in-crease in the total number of leukocytes (by 1.3 times, on average from 2.9*1010/l to 3.8*1010/l)
statement: Experimental data showed that using probiotic-containing feed increased the total number of leukocytes by 1.3 times.
text_en: Experimental data showed that using probiotic-containing feed increased the total number of leukocytes by 1.3 times.

quote: In particular, we registered an increase in the phagocytic index - in the control group it was 35%, in the experi-mental group - 64%
statement: The phagocytic index increased from 35% in the control group to 64% in the experimental group fed with probiotics.
text_en: The phagocytic index increased from 35% in the control group to 64% in the experimental group fed with probiotics.

quote: but no significant changes in the phagocytic number were recorded - 2.6 as opposed to 3 for the control fish.
statement: No significant changes were recorded in the phagocytic number between the groups.
text_en: No significant changes were recorded in the phagocytic number between the groups.

quote: The use of probiotic-containing feed for 28 days led to a change in individual hema-tological indicators - an increase in the number of leukocytes, an increase in phagocytic activity (phag-ocytic index) and caused an increase in the biomass of fish, an increase in feed-eating activity, a positive effect on the physiological state of the external mu-cous membranes, the behavior of fish.
statement: Using probiotic-containing feed for 28 days led to increased leukocyte numbers, phagocytic activity, fish biomass, feeding activity, and had positive effects on mucous membranes and fish behavior.
text_en: Using probiotic-containing feed for 28 days led to increased leukocyte numbers, phagocytic activity, fish biomass, feeding activity, and had positive effects on mucous membranes and fish behavior.

quote: In the experiment replicated after 24 months of female Prussian carp exposure to different doses of lead, similar relationships were observed in the form of lower level of spontaneous LH secretion and prolonged period of higher LH level following hormonal stimulation (Fig. 4b), but the differences were not significant (Table 3).
statement: 在雌性普鲁士鲤鱼暴露于不同剂量铅24个月后的重复实验中，观察到自发性LH分泌水平降低以及激素刺激后LH高水平持续时间延长等相似关系，但差异不显著。
text_zh: 在雌性普鲁士鲤鱼暴露于不同剂量铅24个月后的重复实验中，观察到自发性LH分泌水平降低以及激素刺激后LH高水平持续时间延长等相似关系，但差异不显著。
text_en: In a repeat experiment after female Prussian carp were exposed to different doses of lead for 24 months, similar relationships were observed, including decreased spontaneous LH secretion levels and prolonged duration of high LH levels following hormone stimulation, but the differences were not significant.

quote: Older, mature fish better coped with the exposure to lead, which did not produce such clear effects as those observed after 12 months of exposure to the same doses.
statement: 较年长的成熟鱼更能应对铅暴露，相同剂量下未产生如暴露12个月后观察到的那样明显的效应。
text_zh: 较年长的成熟鱼更能应对铅暴露，相同剂量下未产生如暴露12个月后观察到的那样明显的效应。
text_en: Older mature fish are better able to cope with lead exposure, not producing effects as obvious as those observed after 12 months of exposure at the same dose.

quote: It is also possible that the constant exposure to the action of the same toxicant caused the development of defense mechanisms in fish, which coped with its excess.
statement: 持续暴露于同一种毒物可能导致鱼类发展出防御机制以应对其过量存在。
text_zh: 持续暴露于同一种毒物可能导致鱼类发展出防御机制以应对其过量存在。
text_en: Continuous exposure to the same toxin may lead fish to develop defense mechanisms to cope with its excessive presence.

quote: Considering that some of the major effects of Pb toxicity are attributed to ionoregulatory and hematological alterations, several lines of evidence seem to indicate that fish are able to acclimate, at least to some extent, to Pb during chronic exposures (Mager 2011).
statement: 鉴于铅毒性的主要影响归因于离子调节和血液学改变，多项证据表明鱼类在慢性暴露期间至少在一定程度上能够适应铅。
text_zh: 鉴于铅毒性的主要影响归因于离子调节和血液学改变，多项证据表明鱼类在慢性暴露期间至少在一定程度上能够适应铅。
text_en: Given that the main effects of lead toxicity are attributed to ion regulation and hematological changes, multiple lines of evidence indicate that fish can adapt to lead at least to some extent during chronic exposure.

quote: Carassius gibelio Bloch fish with an average initial weight of 60 g were kept in glass aquariums 40x27x40 cm (water volume was 40 l) at a water temperature of 14°C and a 16-hour photoperiod.
statement: 鲫鱼（Carassius gibelio）在玻璃水族箱中饲养，水温为14°C，光周期为16小时。
text_zh: 鲫鱼（Carassius gibelio）在玻璃水族箱中饲养，水温为14°C，光周期为16小时。
text_en: Crucian carp (Carassius gibelio) were reared in glass aquaria at a water temperature of 14°C and a photoperiod of 16 hours.

quote: The water in the aquariums was changed daily by 3/4 of the volume using a siphon.
statement: 每天使用虹吸法更换四分之三的水量。
text_zh: 每天使用虹吸法更换四分之三的水量。
text_en: Three-quarters of the water volume is replaced daily using a siphon method.

quote: II - fish that received probiotic cultures in the feed substrate. To create probiotic-containing feed, Aller Bronze with a diameter of 3 mm was used as a basis, after wetting with water, Lactobacillus casei was added ... in the amount of CFU 1x1011/g, and the modified feed was regranulated ... The obtained granules were dried for 48 hours.
statement: 实验组II的鱼在饲料基质中接受了益生菌培养物，具体是将干酪乳杆菌添加到Aller Bronze饲料中并重新造粒干燥。
text_zh: 实验组II的鱼在饲料基质中接受了益生菌培养物，具体是将干酪乳杆菌添加到Aller Bronze饲料中并重新造粒干燥。
text_en: Fish in experimental group II received probiotic cultures in the feed substrate, specifically by adding Lactobacillus casei to Aller Bronze feed and re-pelleting and drying it.

quote: Fish were weighed every 7 days of the experiment to assess changes in fish weight.
statement: 每7天对鱼进行称重以评估体重变化。
text_zh: 每7天对鱼进行称重以评估体重变化。
text_en: Fish are weighed every 7 days to assess changes in body weight.

quote: This is supported by the findings of Ruby et al. (2000), who showed that when female rainbow trout were exposed during exogenous vitellogenesis, GSI in control fish was significantly lower than in fish after 12 days of exposure to 10 μg Pb/L.
statement: Ruby等人（2000年）的研究支持这一发现，他们表明当雌性虹鳟在外源性卵黄生成期间暴露时，对照鱼的GSI显著低于暴露于10 μg Pb/L 12天后的鱼。
text_zh: Ruby等人（2000年）的研究支持这一发现，他们表明当雌性虹鳟在外源性卵黄生成期间暴露时，对照鱼的GSI显著低于暴露于10 μg Pb/L 12天后的鱼。
text_en: The study by Ruby et al. (2000) supports this finding, showing that when female rainbow trout were exposed during exogenous vitellogenesis, the GSI of control fish was significantly lower than that of fish exposed to 10 μg Pb/L for 12 days.

quote: Opposite results obtained by Weber (1993) in reproductively mature fathead minnows maintained for 4 weeks in either 0.0 or 0.5 ppm Pb.
statement: Weber（1993年）在维持4周于0.0或0.5 ppm铅中的成熟繁殖黑头米诺鱼中获得了相反的结果。
text_zh: Weber（1993年）在维持4周于0.0或0.5 ppm铅中的成熟繁殖黑头米诺鱼中获得了相反的结果。
text_en: Weber (1993) obtained opposite results in mature breeding blackhead minnows maintained for 4 weeks at 0.0 or 0.5 ppm lead.

quote: Negative, very significant correlation of GSI and Pb concentration in gonads (r = −0,58; p 2).
statement: 性腺体指数（GSI）与性腺中的铅浓度呈负相关且非常显著（r = -0.58; p < 0.02）。
text_zh: 性腺体指数（GSI）与性腺中的铅浓度呈负相关且非常显著（r = -0.58; p < 0.02）。
text_en: The gonadosomatic index (GSI) is negatively and very significantly correlated with lead concentration in the gonads (r = -0.58; p < 0.02).
outcome: 性腺体指数（GSI）与铅积累关系

quote: Often, the consequence of such impacts is a violation of the qualitative and quantitative composition of the microbiota - the autochthonous specific water body and the one that forms the microbiocenosis of the organism of aquatic animals, which leads to the development of diseases.
statement: Наслідком таких впливів часто є порушення якісного та кількісного складу мікробіоти — автохтонної специфічної водойми та тієї, що формує мікроценоз організму водних тварин, що призводить до розвитку хвороб.
text_en: Наслідком таких впливів часто є порушення якісного та кількісного складу мікробіоти — автохтонної специфічної водойми та тієї, що формує мікроценоз організму водних тварин, що призводить до розвитку хвороб.

quote: Recently, the number of studies indicating the positive effect of the use of probiotics as preventive, therapeutic agents and biological factors affecting water quality has been increasing.
statement: Останнім часом зростає кількість досліджень, що вказують на позитивний ефект використання пробіотиків як профілактичних, терапевтичних засобів та біологічних факторів, що впливають на якість води.
text_en: Останнім часом зростає кількість досліджень, що вказують на позитивний ефект використання пробіотиків як профілактичних, терапевтичних засобів та біологічних факторів, що впливають на якість води.
outcome: профілактика та лікування захворювань, якість води

quote: It is worth noting that a similar tendency was not detected when using a regular fodder diet. In the group of control fish, a stable decrease in biomass was noted throughout the experiment.
statement: 值得注意的是，使用常规饲料时未检测到类似趋势；在对照组鱼群中，整个实验期间生物量稳定下降。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，使用常规饲料时未检测到类似趋势；在对照组鱼群中，整个实验期间生物量稳定下降。
text_en: It is worth noting that no similar trend was detected when using conventional feed; in the control group of fish, biomass steadily declined throughout the entire experiment.
counterevidence: 对照组生物量持续下降

quote:
Visual observations made it possible to
state that the fish of the experimental group demon-
strated active behavioral reactions (fast and ori-ented
swimming, immediate reaction to food), high
efficiency of food consumption and moder-ate
sliminess of the skin and no signs of its dark-ening.
statement: Візуальні спостереження показали, що риби експериментальної групи демонстрували активні поведінкові реакції, високу ефективність споживання їжі та помірну слизистість шкіри без ознак потемніння.
text_en: Візуальні спостереження показали, що риби експериментальної групи демонстрували активні поведінкові реакції, високу ефективність споживання їжі та помірну слизистість шкіри без ознак потемніння.

quote:
The characteristics of similar indicators, which
are important for the analysis of fish health, may
indicate the indirect beneficial effect of probiotics on
the speed of adaptation to stress-ful factors (changes
in living conditions).
statement: Характеристики подібних показників можуть свідчити про непрямий позитивний вплив пробіотиків на швидкість адаптації до стресових факторів.
text_en: Характеристики подібних показників можуть свідчити про непрямий позитивний вплив пробіотиків на швидкість адаптації до стресових факторів.

quote:
One of the most important of them is
the stimulation and modulation of im-mune defense.
statement: Однією з найважливіших функцій пробіотиків є стимуляція та модуляція імунного захисту.
text_en: Однією з найважливіших функцій пробіотиків є стимуляція та модуляція імунного захисту.

quote: The water in the tanks was changed every 2 days to maintain a constant metal concentration.
statement: 水箱中的水每两天更换一次，以维持恒定的金属浓度。
text_zh: 水箱中的水每两天更换一次，以维持恒定的金属浓度。
text_en: The water in the tank was changed every two days to maintain a constant metal concentration.

quote: In the case of using probiotics for the needs of large fish farms, it is rational, in our opinion, to use probiotic cultures as part of feed.
statement: 对于大型养鱼场使用益生菌的需求，作者认为将益生菌培养物作为饲料的一部分是合理的。
text_zh: 对于大型养鱼场使用益生菌的需求，作者认为将益生菌培养物作为饲料的一部分是合理的。
text_en: Regarding the need for probiotics in large fish farms, the authors consider it reasonable to include probiotic cultures as part of the feed.

quote: It should be noted that after removing the fish from their permanent habitat and transferring them to aquariums (during the acclimatization period), the fish lost weight, on average, it decreased to 87% of the initial weight.
statement: 值得注意的是，在将鱼从其永久栖息地移出并转移到水族箱后（适应期间），鱼的体重平均下降至初始体重的87%。
text_zh: 值得注意的是，在将鱼从其永久栖息地移出并转移到水族箱后（适应期间），鱼的体重平均下降至初始体重的87%。
text_en: It is worth noting that after moving the fish from their permanent habitat to aquaria (during the acclimation period), the fish's body weight decreased on average to 87% of their initial body weight.

quote: The 28-day use of probiotic-containing feed contributed to a gradual increase in the weight of the experimental fish (Fig. 1). At the terminal stages of the experiment, it exceeded the initial levels, on average, by 16%.
statement: 使用含益生菌饲料28天有助于实验鱼体重的逐渐增加；在实验末期，其体重平均超过初始水平16%。
text_zh: 使用含益生菌饲料28天有助于实验鱼体重的逐渐增加；在实验末期，其体重平均超过初始水平16%。
text_en: Feeding with probiotic-containing feed for 28 days helped the gradual increase in body weight of experimental fish; at the end of the experiment, their body weight averaged 16% above the initial level.

quote: The behavioral changes in the fish were evaluated for anomalies such as difficulty in breathing and gathering around the ventilation filter, slowness in motion, and sinking down to the bottom.
statement: 通过评估呼吸困难、聚集在通气过滤器周围、运动缓慢和沉入水底等异常来评价鱼类的行为变化。
text_zh: 通过评估呼吸困难、聚集在通气过滤器周围、运动缓慢和沉入水底等异常来评价鱼类的行为变化。
text_en: Fish behavioral changes were evaluated by assessing abnormalities such as respiratory distress, aggregation around aeration filters, slow movement, and sinking to the bottom.

quote: The fish were anesthetized with Propiscin (0.3 mL/L; IRS, Żabieniec, Poland) prior to all the manipulations.
statement: 鱼类在进行所有操作前均使用Propiscin进行麻醉。
text_zh: 鱼类在进行所有操作前均使用Propiscin进行麻醉。
text_en: Fish were anesthetized with Propiscin before all procedures.

quote: Blood samples (about 100 μL from each fish) were collected at the beginning of the experiment (basal level) and at 6, 12, and 24 h after the injection from the caudal vein with a 1-mL heparinized syringe.
statement: 通过尾静脉注射肝素化注射器采集血液样本以测定激素水平。
text_zh: 通过尾静脉注射肝素化注射器采集血液样本以测定激素水平。
text_en: Blood samples were collected via the caudal vein using a heparinized syringe to measure hormone levels.

quote: At the end of the experiment (after 5 months’ exposure), the average body weight of fish in the group exposed to 4.0 mg Cd/L was significantly lower in comparison to the 0.4 mg Cd/L, Mel, and blank groups (Table 1).
statement: 实验结束时（暴露5个月后），暴露于4.0 mg Cd/L组的平均体重显著低于0.4 mg Cd/L组、褪黑素组和空白对照组。
text_zh: 实验结束时（暴露5个月后），暴露于4.0 mg Cd/L组的平均体重显著低于0.4 mg Cd/L组、褪黑素组和空白对照组。
text_en: At the end of the experiment (after 5 months of exposure), the mean body weight of the group exposed to 4.0 mg Cd/L was significantly lower than that of the 0.4 mg Cd/L group, the melatonin group, and the blank control group.

quote: The aim of this study was to determine whether melatonin (Mel), which is a known antioxidant and free radical scavenger, could perform the role of a preventive agent against the toxic effects of cadmium (Cd 2+) on mortality, fish growth, gonadosomatic index (GSI), luteinizing hormone (LH) secretion, the response to hormonal stimulation of spawning, and also tissue accumulation of Cd in Prussian carp females.
statement: 研究旨在确定褪黑素是否能作为预防剂，对抗镉对普鲁士鲤鱼雌鱼的死亡率、生长、性腺体指数、黄体生成素分泌及组织镉积累等毒性影响。
text_zh: 研究旨在确定褪黑素是否能作为预防剂，对抗镉对普鲁士鲤鱼雌鱼的死亡率、生长、性腺体指数、黄体生成素分泌及组织镉积累等毒性影响。
text_en: The study aimed to determine whether melatonin could serve as a preventive agent against the toxic effects of cadmium on mortality, growth, gonadosomatic index, luteinizing hormone secretion, and tissue cadmium accumulation in female Prussian carp.

quote: Negative changes caused by exposure to cadmium in the water were as follows: higher fish mortality, lower body weight, increased accumulation of cadmium in the brain and ovary, lowered GSI, impaired spontaneous LH secretion during exposure, and impaired LH secretion during stimulation of spawning.
statement: 水中镉暴露导致的负面变化包括：鱼类死亡率升高、体重降低、脑和卵巢中镉积累增加、性腺体指数降低、暴露期间自发性黄体生成素分泌受损以及产卵刺激期间黄体生成素分泌受损。
text_zh: 水中镉暴露导致的负面变化包括：鱼类死亡率升高、体重降低、脑和卵巢中镉积累增加、性腺体指数降低、暴露期间自发性黄体生成素分泌受损以及产卵刺激期间黄体生成素分泌受损。
text_en: Negative changes caused by cadmium exposure in water include: increased fish mortality, decreased body weight, increased cadmium accumulation in the brain and ovaries, decreased gonadosomatic index, impaired spontaneous luteinizing hormone secretion during the exposure period, and impaired luteinizing hormone secretion during spawning stimulation.

quote: All of these effects were observed in the group of fish exposed to 0.4 and/or 4.0 mg Cd/L but did not occur or were less pronounced in the groups exposed to cadmium in the presence of melatonin released from the implants.
statement: 所有上述负面效应在暴露于0.4和/或4.0 mg Cd/L的鱼群中被观察到，但在存在从植入物释放的褪黑素的情况下暴露于镉的鱼群中未发生或不明显。
text_zh: 所有上述负面效应在暴露于0.4和/或4.0 mg Cd/L的鱼群中被观察到，但在存在从植入物释放的褪黑素的情况下暴露于镉的鱼群中未发生或不明显。
text_en: All the above negative effects were observed in fish groups exposed to 0.4 and/or 4.0 mg Cd/L, but did not occur or were not obvious in fish groups exposed to cadmium in the presence of melatonin released from implants.

quote: During depuration, in the group of fish which had been exposed to the highest Cd concentration, we observed a significant improvement in fish survival rate, body growth, inhibition of further cadmium accumulation in tissues, and gradual return of spontaneous LH secretion as well as normalization of the GSI value to the control group levels.
statement: 在净化期间，暴露于最高浓度镉的鱼群中，观察到存活率、身体生长显著改善，组织中镉进一步积累的抑制，自发性黄体生成素分泌逐渐恢复，以及性腺体指数值恢复正常至对照组水平。
text_zh: 在净化期间，暴露于最高浓度镉的鱼群中，观察到存活率、身体生长显著改善，组织中镉进一步积累的抑制，自发性黄体生成素分泌逐渐恢复，以及性腺体指数值恢复正常至对照组水平。
text_en: During the purification period, in fish groups exposed to the highest concentration of cadmium, significantly improved survival rates and body growth were observed, along with inhibition of further cadmium accumulation in tissues, gradual recovery of spontaneous luteinizing hormone secretion, and gonadosomatic index values returning to normal levels comparable to the control group.

quote: Considering the literature data on cadmium and melatonin interactions in mammals, it seems reasonable to carry out studies aiming to explain whether melatonin, a non-enzymatic compound with anti-oxidative properties, also protects fish organisms against cadmium toxicity.
statement: 鉴于哺乳动物中镉与褪黑素相互作用的文献数据，开展研究以解释具有抗氧化特性的非酶化合物褪黑素是否也能保护鱼类生物体免受镉毒性侵害似乎是合理的。
text_zh: 鉴于哺乳动物中镉与褪黑素相互作用的文献数据，开展研究以解释具有抗氧化特性的非酶化合物褪黑素是否也能保护鱼类生物体免受镉毒性侵害似乎是合理的。
text_en: Given the literature data on the interaction between cadmium and melatonin in mammals, it seems reasonable to conduct research to determine whether melatonin, a non-enzymatic compound with antioxidant properties, can also protect fish organisms from cadmium toxicity.

quote: Melatonin, a hormone principally released by the pineal organ, functions as a non-enzymatic antioxidant and lowers oxidative stress by free radical scavenging or suppression of their synthesis by regulation of antioxidative enzyme activity (Eybl et al. 2006 ; Romero et al. 2011).
statement: 褪黑素是一种主要由松果体释放的激素，作为非酶抗氧化剂发挥作用，并通过清除自由基或通过调节抗氧化酶活性来抑制其合成从而降低氧化应激。
text_zh: 褪黑素是一种主要由松果体释放的激素，作为非酶抗氧化剂发挥作用，并通过清除自由基或通过调节抗氧化酶活性来抑制其合成从而降低氧化应激。
text_en: Melatonin is a hormone primarily released by the pineal gland, which acts as a non-enzymatic antioxidant and reduces oxidative stress by scavenging free radicals or by inhibiting their synthesis through regulating antioxidant enzyme activity.

quote: Metal accumulation in the brain increased steadily over a 5-month period in four Cd-exposed groups, as confirmed by statistically significant coefficients of correlation (Table 2).
statement: 在四个镉暴露组中，脑组织中的金属积累在5个月内稳步增加，并通过统计学上显著的相关系数得到证实。
text_zh: 在四个镉暴露组中，脑组织中的金属积累在5个月内稳步增加，并通过统计学上显著的相关系数得到证实。
text_en: In the four cadmium exposure groups, metal accumulation in brain tissue increased steadily over 5 months, as confirmed by statistically significant correlation coefficients.

quote: A significant increase in Cd concentration was already observed after the first month of the exposure compared to the baseline values in all the experimental groups.
statement: 与基线值相比，在所有实验组中，暴露第一个月后已观察到镉浓度显著增加。
text_zh: 与基线值相比，在所有实验组中，暴露第一个月后已观察到镉浓度显著增加。
text_en: Compared to baseline values, a significant increase in cadmium concentration was observed after the first month of exposure in all experimental groups.

quote: After 5 months of exposure, it was observed that in the cadmium-exposed groups (0.4 mg Cd/L + Mel and 4.0 mg Cd/L + Mel), the impact of melatonin resulted in a statistically significant decrease
statement: 暴露5个月后，观察到在镉暴露组（0.4 mg Cd/L + Mel和4.0 mg Cd/L + Mel）中，褪黑素的影响导致[镉浓度]统计学上显著的降低。
text_zh: 暴露5个月后，观察到在镉暴露组（0.4 mg Cd/L + Mel和4.0 mg Cd/L + Mel）中，褪黑素的影响导致[镉浓度]统计学上显著的降低。
text_en: After 5 months of exposure, a statistically significant reduction in [cadmium concentration] was observed due to the effect of melatonin in the cadmium exposure groups (0.4 mg Cd/L + Mel and 4.0 mg Cd/L + Mel).

quote: Determination of individual indicators of the immune system was carried out in whole blood.
statement: 免疫系统的个体指标测定是在全血中进行的。
text_zh: 免疫系统的个体指标测定是在全血中进行的。
text_en: Individual indicators of the immune system were measured in whole blood.

quote: Blood sampling was carried out from the site of a live incision at the intersection of the tail fin of fish, having previously removed the scales from the punc- ture site and treated it with alcohol to avoid mucus getting into the blood (Lawrence M.J. et al., 2020).
statement: 血液采样是从鱼尾鳍交叉处的活体切口部位进行的，事先去除了穿刺部位的鳞片并用酒精处理以避免粘液进入血液。
text_zh: 血液采样是从鱼尾鳍交叉处的活体切口部位进行的，事先去除了穿刺部位的鳞片并用酒精处理以避免粘液进入血液。
text_en: Blood sampling was performed from a live incision site at the intersection of the fish tail fin, with scales removed from the puncture site beforehand and treated with alcohol to prevent mucus from entering the blood.
outcome: 采样操作对样本质量的影响

quote: The total number of leukocytes was determined and the phagocytic activity of neutrophils was ana- lyzed by a modified method (Simpson D. W. et al., 1979) using a previously prepared yeast suspension.
statement: 白细胞总数通过一种改进方法测定，并使用预先制备的酵母悬浮液分析中性粒细胞的吞噬活性。
text_zh: 白细胞总数通过一种改进方法测定，并使用预先制备的酵母悬浮液分析中性粒细胞的吞噬活性。
text_en: The total white blood cell count was determined by an improved method, and the phagocytic activity of neutrophils was analyzed using a pre-prepared yeast suspension.

quote: The phago- cytic index (the percentage of neutrophils involved in phagocytosis) and the phagocytic number (the average number of yeast captured by one neutrophil) were calculated.
statement: 计算了吞噬指数（参与吞噬的中性粒细胞百分比）和吞噬数（每个中性粒细胞捕获的平均酵母数量）。
text_zh: 计算了吞噬指数（参与吞噬的中性粒细胞百分比）和吞噬数（每个中性粒细胞捕获的平均酵母数量）。
text_en: The phagocytic index (percentage of neutrophils involved in phagocytosis) and the phagocytic number (average number of yeast captured per neutrophil) were calculated.

quote: The diversity of action of probiotics confirms their importance in key areas of successful fish farming, including nutrition of hy- drobionts, control of the environment and strength- ening of resistance of organisms (Wuertz S. et al., 2021).
statement: 益生菌作用的多样性证实了它们在成功鱼类养殖的关键领域的重要性，包括水生生物的营养、环境控制以及增强生物体的抵抗力。
text_zh: 益生菌作用的多样性证实了它们在成功鱼类养殖的关键领域的重要性，包括水生生物的营养、环境控制以及增强生物体的抵抗力。
text_en: The diversity of probiotic effects confirms their importance in key areas of successful fish farming, including nutrition of aquatic organisms, environmental control, and enhancing the resistance of organisms.
outcome: 机体抵抗力与环境控制

quote: Numerous studies carried out on fish proved the toxic effect of cadmium on the nervous, endocrinal, and reproductive systems.
statement: 大量针对鱼类的研究证实了镉对神经系统、内分泌系统和生殖系统的毒性作用。
text_zh: 大量针对鱼类的研究证实了镉对神经系统、内分泌系统和生殖系统的毒性作用。
text_en: Numerous studies on fish have confirmed the toxic effects of cadmium on the nervous, endocrine, and reproductive systems.
outcome: 神经、内分泌及生殖系统健康

quote: This metal can penetrate the blood-brain barrier and accumulate in brain tissues (Pillai et al. 2003).
statement: 镉可以穿透血脑屏障并在脑组织中积累。
text_zh: 镉可以穿透血脑屏障并在脑组织中积累。
text_en: Cadmium can cross the blood-brain barrier and accumulate in brain tissue.

quote: It has been shown that cadmium in fish affects LH secretion, also causing hypertrophy, vacuolization, and degeneration of gonadotropic cells (Szczerbik et al. 2006).
statement: 已证明鱼类体内的镉会影响黄体生成素（LH）的分泌，并导致促性腺细胞肥大、空泡化和变性。
text_zh: 已证明鱼类体内的镉会影响黄体生成素（LH）的分泌，并导致促性腺细胞肥大、空泡化和变性。
text_en: It has been proven that cadmium in fish affects the secretion of luteinizing hormone (LH) and leads to hypertrophy, vacuolization, and degeneration of gonadotroph cells.
outcome: 激素分泌与细胞结构完整性

quote: This metal causes the ovary structure to disintegrate, oolemma necrosis, and follicular cells hypertrophy.
statement: 这种金属会导致卵巢结构解体、卵膜坏死和卵泡细胞肥大。
text_zh: 这种金属会导致卵巢结构解体、卵膜坏死和卵泡细胞肥大。
text_en: This metal causes disintegration of ovarian structure, necrosis of the egg membrane, and hypertrophy of follicular cells.

quote: Seven days before the planned experiment, seven fish from each group were placed in 300 L aquariums (the division into groups was maintained) at a water temperature of 20 °C.
statement: 在计划实验前七天，每组七条鱼被放入300升的水族箱中（保持分组），水温为20°C。
text_zh: 在计划实验前七天，每组七条鱼被放入300升的水族箱中（保持分组），水温为20°C。
text_en: Seven days before the planned experiment, seven fish per group were placed in 300-liter aquaria (maintaining grouping), with a water temperature of 20°C.

quote: The cadmium concentration in fish brains after 3 months of exposure and the subsequent 2-month depuration is shown in Table 2 .
statement: 表2展示了鱼类在暴露于镉3个月及随后净化2个月后脑中的镉浓度。
text_zh: 表2展示了鱼类在暴露于镉3个月及随后净化2个月后脑中的镉浓度。
text_en: Table 2 shows the cadmium concentrations in the brains of fish after 3 months of exposure to cadmium and subsequent depuration for 2 months.

quote: After the first month of depuration, further growth was observed in the cadmium concentration in the brain of the fish which had been exposed to the highest doses of this metal.
statement: 在暴露于最高剂量镉后，经过第一个月的净化期，鱼脑中的镉浓度进一步增加。
text_zh: 在暴露于最高剂量镉后，经过第一个月的净化期，鱼脑中的镉浓度进一步增加。
text_en: After exposure to the highest dose of cadmium, during the first month of depuration, the cadmium concentration in fish brains further increased.
counterevidence: 净化初期脑部镉浓度不降反升

quote: The highest mortality of fish (3%) was found in the group exposed to the higher cadmium dose compared to other groups.
statement: 暴露于较高镉剂量的鱼群死亡率最高，达到3%。
text_zh: 暴露于较高镉剂量的鱼群死亡率最高，达到3%。
text_en: Fish groups exposed to higher cadmium doses had the highest mortality, reaching 3%.

quote: Melatonin-treated fish were found to be healthy throughout the observation period, and there was no mortality noted.
statement: 褪黑素处理的鱼在整个观察期内保持健康，未记录到死亡情况。
text_zh: 褪黑素处理的鱼在整个观察期内保持健康，未记录到死亡情况。
text_en: Melatonin-treated fish remained healthy throughout the observation period, with no deaths recorded.

quote: Successive measurements of fish body weight showed gradual inhibition of their growth in the group exposed to the highest cadmium dose in water (4.0 mg Cd/L).
statement: 连续测量显示，暴露于水中最高镉剂量（4.0 mg Cd/L）的鱼群生长受到逐渐抑制。
text_zh: 连续测量显示，暴露于水中最高镉剂量（4.0 mg Cd/L）的鱼群生长受到逐渐抑制。
text_en: Continuous measurements showed that the growth of fish exposed to the highest dose of cadmium in water (4.0 mg Cd/L) was gradually inhibited.

quote: After the first month of depuration, body weight in group 4.0 mg Cd/L remained statistically significantly lower in comparison to the control group and group 0.4 mg Cd/L.
statement: 在净化第一个月后，暴露于4.0 mg Cd/L组的鱼体重显著低于对照组和0.4 mg Cd/L组。
text_zh: 在净化第一个月后，暴露于4.0 mg Cd/L组的鱼体重显著低于对照组和0.4 mg Cd/L组。
text_en: After the first month of depuration, the body weight of fish in the group exposed to 4.0 mg Cd/L was significantly lower than that of the control group and the 0.4 mg Cd/L group.

quote: In the group exposed to the highest cadmium doses, a decrease in locomotive activity and appetite was observed.
statement: 在暴露于最高剂量镉的组中，观察到运动活性和食欲下降。
text_zh: 在暴露于最高剂量镉的组中，观察到运动活性和食欲下降。
text_en: In the group exposed to the highest dose of cadmium, decreased locomotor activity and appetite were observed.

quote: Melatonin stopped the decrease in locomotive activity in fish from the group exposed to the highest cadmium doses.
statement: 褪黑素阻止了暴露于最高剂量镉组中鱼类运动活性的下降。
text_zh: 褪黑素阻止了暴露于最高剂量镉组中鱼类运动活性的下降。
text_en: Melatonin prevented the decrease in locomotor activity of fish in the group exposed to the highest dose of cadmium.

quote: The fish were kept in 7 tanks (700 L, 49 fish per tank) under a simulated, natural photoperiod (L/D = 14:10).
statement: 鱼类被饲养在7个水箱中（每个700升，每箱49条鱼），并在模拟的自然光周期（光照/黑暗=14:10）下管理。
text_zh: 鱼类被饲养在7个水箱中（每个700升，每箱49条鱼），并在模拟的自然光周期（光照/黑暗=14:10）下管理。
text_en: Fish were reared in 7 tanks (each 700 liters, with 49 fish per tank) and managed under a simulated natural photoperiod (light/dark = 14:10).

quote: The physicochemical characteristics of the experimental water... were as follows: temperature 18 °C, pH = 7.6, dissolved oxygen concentration 9.5 mg/L, and water hardness 186 mg CaCO 3 /L.
statement: 实验水的物理化学特征为：温度18°C，pH值7.6，溶解氧浓度9.5 mg/L，水硬度186 mg CaCO3/L。
text_zh: 实验水的物理化学特征为：温度18°C，pH值7.6，溶解氧浓度9.5 mg/L，水硬度186 mg CaCO3/L。
text_en: The physicochemical characteristics of the experimental water were: temperature 18°C, pH 7.6, dissolved oxygen concentration 9.5 mg/L, and water hardness 186 mg CaCO3/L.

quote: In addition, the water was filtered and aerated.
statement: 此外，水经过过滤和曝气处理。
text_zh: 此外，水经过过滤和曝气处理。
text_en: In addition, the water was filtered and aerated.

quote: During the 3-month acclimation period and throughout the experiment, the fish were hand-fed with commercial dry pellets.
statement: 在3个月的适应期及整个实验期间，鱼类通过人工投喂商业干颗粒饲料。
text_zh: 在3个月的适应期及整个实验期间，鱼类通过人工投喂商业干颗粒饲料。
text_en: During the 3-month acclimation period and throughout the entire experiment, fish were fed commercial dry pellet feed by hand.

quote: Throughout the study, the fish were fed once daily a ration that amounted to 3% of their body weight.
statement: 在整个研究过程中，鱼类每天投喂一次，投喂量为其体重的3%。
text_zh: 在整个研究过程中，鱼类每天投喂一次，投喂量为其体重的3%。
text_en: Throughout the study, fish were fed once daily at a rate of 3% of their body weight.

quote: In the depuration period, melatonin caused a statistically significant Cd concentration decrease in the gonads of fish exposed to the highest cadmium dose after both the first and second months of depuration (Table 2).
statement: 在净化期间，褪黑素导致暴露于最高剂量镉的鱼类性腺中的镉浓度在第一个和第二个净化月后均出现统计学上的显著降低。
text_zh: 在净化期间，褪黑素导致暴露于最高剂量镉的鱼类性腺中的镉浓度在第一个和第二个净化月后均出现统计学上的显著降低。
text_en: During the depuration period, melatonin caused a statistically significant reduction in cadmium concentration in the gonads of fish exposed to the highest dose of cadmium after both the first and second months of depuration.

quote: One of the possible reasons for that could be the direct toxic effect of cadmium on the hypothalamus and the pituitary gland.
statement: 可能的原因之一是镉对下丘脑和垂体的直接毒性作用。
text_zh: 可能的原因之一是镉对下丘脑和垂体的直接毒性作用。
text_en: One possible reason is the direct toxic effect of cadmium on the hypothalamus and pituitary gland.

quote: Melatonin, which is considered to be an anti-stress hormone, mitigates the effects of stress and increases resistance in fish (Singh et al. 2015 ; Jung et al. 2016).
statement: 褪黑素被认为是一种抗应激激素，能减轻鱼类的应激影响并提高其抵抗力。
text_zh: 褪黑素被认为是一种抗应激激素，能减轻鱼类的应激影响并提高其抵抗力。
text_en: Melatonin is considered an anti-stress hormone that can reduce the stress effects on fish and improve their resistance.

quote: Melatonin did not affect body weight, but it clearly reduced fish mortality, since there were no cases of death in the groups of fish exposed to cadmium with implants that continuously released melatonin.
statement: 褪黑素不影响体重，但通过连续释放的植入物显著降低了暴露于镉的鱼类的死亡率。
text_zh: 褪黑素不影响体重，但通过连续释放的植入物显著降低了暴露于镉的鱼类的死亡率。
text_en: Melatonin does not affect body weight, but significantly reduced the mortality of fish exposed to cadmium through continuous-release implants.

quote: It may be assumed that one of the reasons for the reduction in the mortality rate was melatonin’s immunostimulating effect (Singh et al. 2015).
statement: 死亡率降低的一个原因可能是褪黑素的免疫刺激作用。
text_zh: 死亡率降低的一个原因可能是褪黑素的免疫刺激作用。
text_en: One possible reason for the reduced mortality rate is the immunostimulatory effect of melatonin.

quote: The present study shows the inhibition of locomotor activity in fish exposed to the highest concentration of cadmium in water.
statement: 本研究表明，暴露于水中最高浓度镉的鱼类的运动活动受到抑制。
text_zh: 本研究表明，暴露于水中最高浓度镉的鱼类的运动活动受到抑制。
text_en: This study shows that the locomotor activity of fish exposed to the highest concentration of cadmium in water was inhibited.

quote: In this study, melatonin counteracted the inhibitive effect of cadmium on locomotor activity of fish, which was reflected in greater freedom of breathing and swimming, and increased mobility.
statement: 在本研究中，褪黑素抵消了镉对鱼类运动活动的抑制作用，表现为呼吸和游泳更自由以及活动性增加。
text_zh: 在本研究中，褪黑素抵消了镉对鱼类运动活动的抑制作用，表现为呼吸和游泳更自由以及活动性增加。
text_en: In this study, melatonin counteracted the inhibitory effect of cadmium on fish locomotor activity, manifested as more free breathing and swimming and increased activity.

quote: In the study by Singh et al. (2015), melatonin reduced aggression in Channa punctatus induced by exposure to cadmium.
statement: 在Singh等人（2015）的研究中，褪黑素减少了由镉暴露引起的Channa punctatus的攻击性。
text_zh: 在Singh等人（2015）的研究中，褪黑素减少了由镉暴露引起的Channa punctatus的攻击性。
text_en: In the study by Singh et al. (2015), melatonin reduced the aggression in Channa punctatus caused by cadmium exposure.

quote: The present study is the first to observe a preventive effect of melatonin against the neurotoxic influence of cadmium in fish at the level of the brain.
statement: 本研究首次观察到褪黑素对鱼类大脑水平上镉神经毒性影响的预防作用。
text_zh: 本研究首次观察到褪黑素对鱼类大脑水平上镉神经毒性影响的预防作用。
text_en: This study is the first to observe the preventive effect of melatonin on cadmium neurotoxicity at the brain level in fish.

quote: In the group of females which were exposed to the highest cadmium doses (4.0 mg Cd/L), a statistically significant increase in cadmium concentration was observed compared to the control and the remaining groups in every sample (month).
statement: 在暴露于最高剂量镉（4.0 mg Cd/L）的雌性组中，与对照组和其他组相比，每个样本（月份）均观察到镉浓度统计学显著增加。
text_zh: 在暴露于最高剂量镉（4.0 mg Cd/L）的雌性组中，与对照组和其他组相比，每个样本（月份）均观察到镉浓度统计学显著增加。
text_en: In the female group exposed to the highest dose of cadmium (4.0 mg Cd/L), a statistically significant increase in cadmium concentration was observed in each sample (month) compared with the control group and other groups.

quote: After the second month of depuration, a decrease in LH concentration was observed in all groups and the fish—also those which had been exposed to cadmium—gradually returned to normal functioning.
statement: 在净化的第二个月后，所有组的LH浓度均下降，鱼类（包括曾暴露于镉的鱼）逐渐恢复正常功能。
text_zh: 在净化的第二个月后，所有组的LH浓度均下降，鱼类（包括曾暴露于镉的鱼）逐渐恢复正常功能。
text_en: After the second month of depuration, LH concentrations decreased in all groups, and fish (including those exposed to cadmium) gradually returned to normal function.

quote: Cadmium added to the feed of zebrafish and sheepshead minnows reduced the percentage of live eggs and impeded their production (Karels et al. 2003).
statement: 添加到斑马鱼和羊头鲦鱼饲料中的镉减少了活卵百分比并阻碍了其生产。
text_zh: 添加到斑马鱼和羊头鲦鱼饲料中的镉减少了活卵百分比并阻碍了其生产。
text_en: Cadmium added to the feed of zebrafish and sheephead minnows reduced the percentage of live eggs and hindered their production.

quote: Such an increase was also noted by Allen (1995) in the study on Oreochromis aureus after a long-term exposure to cadmium in water.
statement: Allen (1995) 在奥利亚罗非鱼长期水体镉暴露研究中也注意到了这种增加。
text_zh: Allen (1995) 在奥利亚罗非鱼长期水体镉暴露研究中也注意到了这种增加。
text_en: Allen (1995) also noted this increase in a study on long-term waterborne cadmium exposure in Oreochromis aureus.

quote: The accumulation of this metal in the brain leads to histopathological changes, i.e., tissue disorganization, mitochondria swelling with a loss of cristae, vacuolization, and dystrophy (large autophagic vacuoles)
statement: 该金属在大脑中的积累导致组织病理学变化，即组织紊乱、线粒体肿胀伴嵴消失、空泡化和营养不良（大型自噬空泡）。
text_zh: 该金属在大脑中的积累导致组织病理学变化，即组织紊乱、线粒体肿胀伴嵴消失、空泡化和营养不良（大型自噬空泡）。
text_en: The accumulation of this metal in the brain led to histopathological changes, namely tissue disorganization, mitochondrial swelling with loss of cristae, vacuolization and dystrophy (large autophagic vacuoles).

quote: Moreover, cadmium causes hyperemia, along with cell and axon necrosis in the brain
statement: 此外，镉会导致大脑充血以及细胞和轴突坏死。
text_zh: 此外，镉会导致大脑充血以及细胞和轴突坏死。
text_en: In addition, cadmium causes brain congestion and necrosis of cells and axons.

quote: Kumari and Dutt (1991) demonstrated overgrowth and vacuolization of the pituitary gland cells in Puntius sarana .
statement: Kumari 和 Dutt (1991) 证明了 Sarana 鲃垂体细胞的过度生长和空泡化。
text_zh: Kumari 和 Dutt (1991) 证明了 Sarana 鲃垂体细胞的过度生长和空泡化。
text_en: Kumari and Dutt (1991) demonstrated hypertrophy and vacuolization of pituitary cells in Sarana barb.

quote: Therefore, it probably protects the brain from the neurotoxic effects of cadmium.
statement: 因此，它可能保护大脑免受镉的神经毒性影响。
text_zh: 因此，它可能保护大脑免受镉的神经毒性影响。
text_en: Therefore, it may protect the brain from the neurotoxic effects of cadmium.

quote: Acute toxicity values of propofol for gold fish were found 96 h LC50 6.353 mg/L, 96 h LC1 2.966 mg/L and 96 h LC99 13.609 mg/L.
statement: 研究测定了丙泊酚对金鱼（Carassius auratus）的急性毒性值，包括96小时LC50、LC1和LC99。
text_zh: 研究测定了丙泊酚对金鱼（Carassius auratus）的急性毒性值，包括96小时LC50、LC1和LC99。
text_en: The study determined the acute toxicity values of propofol for goldfish (Carassius auratus), including 96-hour LC50, LC1, and LC99.

quote: Time to induce anesthesia in propofol experiment was significantly higher than Clove oil (p 0.05).
statement: 与丁香油相比，使用丙泊酚诱导麻醉所需的时间显著更长。
text_zh: 与丁香油相比，使用丙泊酚诱导麻醉所需的时间显著更长。
text_en: Compared with clove oil, the time required to induce anesthesia with propofol was significantly longer.

quote: MCHC (%) level of propofol experiment (13.93 ± 1.36) showed significant (p
statement: 丙泊酚实验组的平均血红蛋白浓度（MCHC）水平显示出显著性差异（原文截断）。
text_zh: 丙泊酚实验组的平均血红蛋白浓度（MCHC）水平显示出显著性差异（原文截断）。
text_en: The mean corpuscular hemoglobin concentration (MCHC) levels in the propofol experimental group showed significant differences (original text truncated).

quote: Some anaesthetics reduce or block the activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-interrenal (HPI) axis associated with stressors and thus decrease or prevent the release of the stress hormone cortisol to the bloodstream of fish (Hoskonen and Pirhonen 2006).
statement: 一些麻醉剂通过减少或阻断与应激源相关的下丘脑-垂体-间肾轴（HPI）的激活，从而降低或阻止应激激素皮质醇释放到鱼的血液中。
text_zh: 一些麻醉剂通过减少或阻断与应激源相关的下丘脑-垂体-间肾轴（HPI）的激活，从而降低或阻止应激激素皮质醇释放到鱼的血液中。
text_en: Some anesthetics reduce or block the release of the stress hormone cortisol into fish blood by reducing or blocking the activation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-interrenal (HPI) axis associated with stressors.

quote: A significant positive correlation between Cd brain concentration and cadmium dose during the exposure in different groups was noted (Table 2).
statement: 注意到在不同组别的暴露期间，脑镉浓度与镉剂量之间存在显著的正相关关系。
text_zh: 注意到在不同组别的暴露期间，脑镉浓度与镉剂量之间存在显著的正相关关系。
text_en: A significant positive correlation between brain cadmium concentration and cadmium dose was observed during the exposure period in different groups.

quote: After 3 months of exposure, the fish entered the spawning period and the level of spontaneous LH secretion increased in the control groups, while in groups 4.0 mg Cd/L + Mel and 4.0 mg Cd/L, a statistically significant lower LH concentration was observed.
statement: 暴露3个月后，鱼类进入产卵期，对照组的自发LH分泌水平增加，而在4.0 mg Cd/L + 褪黑素组和4.0 mg Cd/L组中，观察到统计学上显著较低的LH浓度。
text_zh: 暴露3个月后，鱼类进入产卵期，对照组的自发LH分泌水平增加，而在4.0 mg Cd/L + 褪黑素组和4.0 mg Cd/L组中，观察到统计学上显著较低的LH浓度。
text_en: After 3 months of exposure, the fish entered the spawning period. Spontaneous LH secretion levels increased in the control group, while statistically significantly lower LH concentrations were observed in the 4.0 mg Cd/L + melatonin group and the 4.0 mg Cd/L group.
outcome: 繁殖生理/产卵期激素调节
counterevidence: 高剂量镉及镉加褪黑素处理均抑制了产卵期的LH正常升高

quote: This increase probably stemmed from an elevated level of cadmium in the blood as a result of its elimination from tissues that had accumulated a large amount of this metal.
statement: LH浓度的增加可能源于血液镉水平升高，这是镉从积累大量该金属的组织中排出的结果。
text_zh: LH浓度的增加可能源于血液镉水平升高，这是镉从积累大量该金属的组织中排出的结果。
text_en: The increase in LH concentration may result from elevated blood cadmium levels, which is a consequence of cadmium being released from tissues that have accumulated large amounts of this metal.

quote: It is likely that cadmium had a neurotoxic effect at the level of the brain by disturbing synthesis and release of neurotransmitters.
statement: 镉很可能通过干扰神经递质的合成和释放，在大脑水平产生神经毒性作用。
text_zh: 镉很可能通过干扰神经递质的合成和释放，在大脑水平产生神经毒性作用。
text_en: Cadmium likely produces neurotoxic effects at the brain level by interfering with the synthesis and release of neurotransmitters.

quote: In all cases, the negative effects of cadmium were most likely inhibited by melatonin.
statement: 在所有情况下，镉的负面影响最有可能被褪黑素抑制。
text_zh: 在所有情况下，镉的负面影响最有可能被褪黑素抑制。
text_en: In all cases, the negative effects of cadmium were most likely inhibited by melatonin.

quote: The effects of melatonin point to a possible role of this indoleamine as a preventive agent for environmental Cd contamination.
statement: 褪黑素的作用表明这种吲哚胺作为环境镉污染预防剂的潜在作用。
text_zh: 褪黑素的作用表明这种吲哚胺作为环境镉污染预防剂的潜在作用。
text_en: The effect of melatonin indicates the potential role of this indoleamine as a preventive agent against environmental cadmium pollution.

quote: Any abnormal behavior or mortalities were recorded during this 14-day recovery period.
statement: 在14天的恢复期内记录了任何异常行为或死亡情况。
text_zh: 在14天的恢复期内记录了任何异常行为或死亡情况。
text_en: Any abnormal behavior or mortality was recorded during the 14-day recovery period.

quote: Table 1 Stages of anesthesia with clove oil in fish (Keene et al., 1998 , modified from McFarland, 1959 ; Jolly et al. 1972) and Stages of recovery from anesthesia in fish (Keene et al., 1998 modified from Hikasa et al., 1986) in fish
statement: 表1列出了鱼类使用丁香油麻醉的阶段以及从麻醉中恢复的阶段，引用了先前的研究。
text_zh: 表1列出了鱼类使用丁香油麻醉的阶段以及从麻醉中恢复的阶段，引用了先前的研究。
text_en: Table 1 lists the stages of eugenol anesthesia in fish and the stages of recovery from anesthesia, citing previous studies.
outcome: 麻醉与恢复阶段的行为及生理指标

quote: For the haematological blood profile tests, in experimental I twenty of gold fish anesthetized with 7 ppm propofol were examined immediately after 10 min anaesthesia.
statement: 在实验I中，对二十条用7 ppm丙泊酚麻醉的金鱼进行了血液学检查，检查在麻醉10分钟后立即进行。
text_zh: 在实验I中，对二十条用7 ppm丙泊酚麻醉的金鱼进行了血液学检查，检查在麻醉10分钟后立即进行。
text_en: In Experiment I, hematological examinations were performed on twenty goldfish anesthetized with 7 ppm propofol, immediately after 10 minutes of anesthesia.

quote: We observed a significant increase in the cadmium concentration in the gonads of fish exposed to the highest dose of this metal.
statement: 观察到暴露于最高剂量该金属的鱼性腺中镉浓度显著增加。
text_zh: 观察到暴露于最高剂量该金属的鱼性腺中镉浓度显著增加。
text_en: Cadmium concentrations in the gonads of fish exposed to the highest dose of this metal were significantly increased.

quote: Changes in the ovary of Heteropneustes fossilis were also observed by Sharma et al. (2011). These changes included degeneration in the ovarian follicles, as well as a change in the nucleus and in the appearance of atretic follicles.
statement: Sharma等人（2011）也观察到了Heteropneustes fossilis卵巢的变化，包括卵巢滤泡退化、核变化以及闭锁滤泡的出现。
text_zh: Sharma等人（2011）也观察到了Heteropneustes fossilis卵巢的变化，包括卵巢滤泡退化、核变化以及闭锁滤泡的出现。
text_en: Sharma et al. (2011) also observed changes in the ovaries of Heteropneustes fossilis, including follicular degeneration, nuclear changes, and the appearance of atretic follicles.

quote: In experiment II twenty of gold fish anesthetized with 30 ppm clove oil were examined immediately after 10 min anaesthesia and in Control group twenty of fish without any anesthesia were hematologicaly tested.
statement: 在实验II中，二十条用30 ppm丁香油麻醉的金鱼在麻醉10分钟后立即进行了血液学检查，对照组二十条未麻醉的鱼也进行了血液学测试。
text_zh: 在实验II中，二十条用30 ppm丁香油麻醉的金鱼在麻醉10分钟后立即进行了血液学检查，对照组二十条未麻醉的鱼也进行了血液学测试。
text_en: In Experiment II, twenty goldfish anesthetized with 30 ppm clove oil underwent hematological examination immediately after 10 minutes of anesthesia, and twenty unanesthetized fish in the control group also underwent hematological testing.

quote: 96-h LC50 propofol of gold fish placed into the higher concentration (16 ppm) initially exhibited irritation, as evidenced by rapidly darting about the aquaria, the mortality of this concentration was 100% after 30 min.
statement: 将金鱼置于高浓度（16 ppm）丙泊酚中，初期表现为烦躁不安（在鱼缸中快速游动），该浓度下30分钟后死亡率为100%。
text_zh: 将金鱼置于高浓度（16 ppm）丙泊酚中，初期表现为烦躁不安（在鱼缸中快速游动），该浓度下30分钟后死亡率为100%。
text_en: Placing goldfish in high-concentration (16 ppm) propofol initially resulted in restlessness (rapid swimming in the tank), with a mortality rate of 100% after 30 minutes at this concentration.
counterevidence: 高浓度导致急性应激和快速死亡

quote: Moreover, recovery is observed to be rapid, uncomplicated and complete.
statement: 恢复过程被观察到是快速、无并发症且完全的。
text_zh: 恢复过程被观察到是快速、无并发症且完全的。
text_en: Recovery was observed to be rapid, uncomplicated and complete.

quote: Propofol has been used for inducing anesthesia in reptiles such as green iguanas (Knotkova et al. 2005 (Fleming et al.) and some fish species such as Acipencer oxyrinchus De soti 2003) and in spotted bamboo sharks () (Miller et al. Chiloscyllium plagiosum 2005), but the efficacy and safety of any anaesthetic agent vary among species, life stages and environmental conditions, and more studies are needed to take advantage of this anesthetic in ornamental fish.
statement: 丙泊酚已用于诱导爬行动物和一些鱼类及鲨鱼的麻醉，但任何麻醉剂的效力和安全性因物种、生命阶段和环境条件而异，需要更多研究以在观赏鱼中利用这种麻醉剂。
text_zh: 丙泊酚已用于诱导爬行动物和一些鱼类及鲨鱼的麻醉，但任何麻醉剂的效力和安全性因物种、生命阶段和环境条件而异，需要更多研究以在观赏鱼中利用这种麻醉剂。
text_en: Propofol has been used to induce anesthesia in reptiles and some fish and sharks, but the efficacy and safety of any anesthetic vary by species, life stage, and environmental conditions, requiring further research to utilize this anesthetic in ornamental fish.
limitations: 效力和安全性因物种、生命阶段和环境条件而异

quote: Gold fish were exposed to varying doses of propofol to determine the 96-h LC50, as well as exposure to both propofol and eugenol to observe differences in anesthesia onset and recovery times, to determine the proper dosage and to evaluate selected blood parameters during anaesthesia with propofol in gold fish (Carassius auratus).
statement: 金鱼暴露于不同剂量的丙泊酚以确定96小时LC50，并暴露于丙泊酚和丁香酚以观察麻醉开始和恢复时间的差异，确定适当剂量并评估丙泊酚麻醉期间选定的血液参数。
text_zh: 金鱼暴露于不同剂量的丙泊酚以确定96小时LC50，并暴露于丙泊酚和丁香酚以观察麻醉开始和恢复时间的差异，确定适当剂量并评估丙泊酚麻醉期间选定的血液参数。
text_en: Goldfish were exposed to different doses of propofol to determine the 96-hour LC50, and exposed to propofol and eugenol to observe differences in anesthesia onset and recovery times, to determine appropriate doses and evaluate selected blood parameters during propofol anesthesia.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉
outcome: 麻醉起效时间、恢复时间及血液参数

quote: In conclusion, the result of this study indicated that propofol (7 ppm) can induce safe and valid anaesthesia in gold fish.
statement: 本研究的结论表明，7 ppm的丙泊酚可以在金鱼中诱导安全且有效的麻醉。
text_zh: 本研究的结论表明，7 ppm的丙泊酚可以在金鱼中诱导安全且有效的麻醉。
text_en: The conclusions of this study indicate that 7 ppm propofol can induce safe and effective anesthesia in goldfish.

quote: However, it seems that further studies on different dosage, also measuring more haematological and biochemical parameters in the gold fish and other (non-food) ornamental fish following anaesthesia with propofol are needed.
statement: 然而，似乎需要进一步研究不同剂量，并在用丙泊酚麻醉后测量金鱼和其他（非食用）观赏鱼更多的血液学和生化参数。
text_zh: 然而，似乎需要进一步研究不同剂量，并在用丙泊酚麻醉后测量金鱼和其他（非食用）观赏鱼更多的血液学和生化参数。
text_en: However, further research on different doses and measurement of more hematological and biochemical parameters in goldfish and other (non-edible) ornamental fish after propofol anesthesia seem to be needed.
outcome: 麻醉对血液学和生化指标的影响
limitations: 需要进一步研究不同剂量及更多血液学和生化参数

quote: No significant decrease was found in Total RBC, HCT, WBC, MCH, MCV and leukogram indices (p > 0.05).
statement: 丙泊酚和丁香油麻醉未导致总红细胞、血细胞比容、白细胞、平均血红蛋白量、平均红细胞体积和白细胞分类指数显著下降。
text_zh: 丙泊酚和丁香油麻醉未导致总红细胞、血细胞比容、白细胞、平均血红蛋白量、平均红细胞体积和白细胞分类指数显著下降。
text_en: Propofol and clove oil anesthesia did not cause a significant decrease in total red blood cells, hematocrit, white blood cells, mean corpuscular hemoglobin, mean corpuscular volume, and white blood cell differential indices.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉

quote: MCHC level of propofol experiment (13.93 ± 1.36) showed significant (p < 0.05) decrease than Clove oil experiment (94.95 ± 24.50) and control (62.46 ± 21.90).
statement: 丙泊酚实验组的平均血红蛋白浓度显著低于丁香油实验组和对照组。
text_zh: 丙泊酚实验组的平均血红蛋白浓度显著低于丁香油实验组和对照组。
text_en: The mean hemoglobin concentration in the propofol experimental group was significantly lower than that in the clove oil experimental group and the control group.

quote: Decrease in Hb content (5.20 ± 0.73) was observed in propofol exposure compared with control (15.41 ± 4.76) and clove oil experiment (25.39 ± 5.73) (p < 0.05).
statement: 与对照组和丁香油实验组相比，丙泊酚暴露组的血红蛋白含量显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组和丁香油实验组相比，丙泊酚暴露组的血红蛋白含量显著降低。
text_en: Compared to the control group and the clove oil experimental group, hemoglobin content was significantly lower in the propofol exposure group.

quote: The analysis of blood parameters is one of the most valuable methods of anaesthetics evaluation, because it has been shown that the physiological effects of anaesthetics are species-specific and age-dependent (Anver Celik 2004).
statement: 血液参数分析是评估麻醉剂最有价值的方法之一，因为麻醉剂的生理效应具有物种特异性和年龄依赖性。
text_zh: 血液参数分析是评估麻醉剂最有价值的方法之一，因为麻醉剂的生理效应具有物种特异性和年龄依赖性。
text_en: Analysis of blood parameters is one of the most valuable methods for evaluating anesthetics, because the physiological effects of anesthetics are species-specific and age-dependent.

quote: The first three concentrations (0.5. 1 and 2 ppm) survived the 96 h trial with 0% mortality.
statement: 前三个浓度（0.5、1和2 ppm）的金鱼在96小时试验中存活，死亡率为0%。
text_zh: 前三个浓度（0.5、1和2 ppm）的金鱼在96小时试验中存活，死亡率为0%。
text_en: Goldfish in the first three concentrations (0.5, 1, and 2 ppm) survived during the 96-hour test, with a mortality rate of 0%.

quote: In concentration of 4 ppm deep sedation was observed after 10 min, with only one mortality after 24 h of exposure.
statement: 在4 ppm浓度下，10分钟后观察到深度镇静，暴露24小时后仅有一例死亡。
text_zh: 在4 ppm浓度下，10分钟后观察到深度镇静，暴露24小时后仅有一例死亡。
text_en: At a concentration of 4 ppm, deep sedation was observed after 10 minutes, with only one death occurring after 24 hours of exposure.

quote: The time required to induce anesthesia using propofol was significantly higher than Clove oil
statement: 使用丙泊酚诱导麻醉所需的时间显著高于丁香油。
text_zh: 使用丙泊酚诱导麻醉所需的时间显著高于丁香油。
text_en: The time required for propofol-induced anesthesia was significantly higher than that of clove oil.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉
counterevidence: 丙泊酚起效慢于丁香油

quote: Changes in the haematological parameters of gold fish in the control group and those exposed to propofol and clove oil are presented in Tables 3 and 4 .
statement: 对照组以及暴露于丙泊酚和丁香油的金鱼血液学参数的变化如表3和表4所示。
text_zh: 对照组以及暴露于丙泊酚和丁香油的金鱼血液学参数的变化如表3和表4所示。
text_en: Changes in hematological parameters of goldfish in the control group and those exposed to propofol and clove oil are shown in Tables 3 and 4.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉

quote: Anesthetics act on the central nervous system in such a way with placing the fish into an anaesthetic solution that is absorbed through the gills and enters the arterial blood, then with the returning of the anaesthetised fish to the fresh water, the anaesthetics or their metabolites are excreted via the gills (Ross and Ross 1999).
statement: 麻醉剂通过鱼鳃吸收进入动脉血液作用于中枢神经系统，当鱼回到清水中时，麻醉剂或其代谢物通过鳃排出。
text_zh: 麻醉剂通过鱼鳃吸收进入动脉血液作用于中枢神经系统，当鱼回到清水中时，麻醉剂或其代谢物通过鳃排出。
text_en: Anesthetics are absorbed through the fish gills into arterial blood and act on the central nervous system; when the fish is returned to clean water, the anesthetic or its metabolites are excreted through the gills.

quote: Propofol (2,6 diisopropyl phenol) is an ultra-short–acting sedative agent with no analgesic properties, which provides sedative and anesthetic effects (Kay and Stephenson 1980).
statement: 丙泊酚是一种超短效镇静剂，无镇痛特性，但提供镇静和麻醉效果。
text_zh: 丙泊酚是一种超短效镇静剂，无镇痛特性，但提供镇静和麻醉效果。
text_en: Propofol is an ultra-short-acting sedative with no analgesic properties, but it provides sedation and anesthesia effects.

quote: It is reported to reduce both sympathetic and parasympathetic tone; however, it is not clear whether the changes in heart rate variability are associated with depth of anesthesia.
statement: 据报道丙泊酚可降低交感和副交感张力，但心率变异性的变化是否与麻醉深度相关尚不清楚。
text_zh: 据报道丙泊酚可降低交感和副交感张力，但心率变异性的变化是否与麻醉深度相关尚不清楚。
text_en: It is reported that propofol can reduce sympathetic and parasympathetic tone, but it is unclear whether changes in heart rate variability are related to the depth of anesthesia.
outcome: 自主神经张力与心率变异性

quote: It is generally considered safe for use in animals with renal or hepatic disease also most in instances of mild to moderate heart disease with appropriate monitoring and support.
statement: 在适当的监测和支持下，丙泊酚通常被认为对患有肾脏或肝脏疾病以及大多数轻度至中度心脏疾病的动物是安全的。
text_zh: 在适当的监测和支持下，丙泊酚通常被认为对患有肾脏或肝脏疾病以及大多数轻度至中度心脏疾病的动物是安全的。
text_en: With appropriate monitoring and support, propofol is generally considered safe for animals with kidney or liver disease and most mild to moderate heart diseases.
limitations: 需要适当的监测和支持

quote: Propofol is a short-acting, rapidly metabolized agent, which is characterized by a virtual lack of any cumulative effect and by rapid recovery after its administration in bolus doses or by continuous infusion.
statement: 丙泊酚是一种短效、快速代谢的药物，其特征是几乎没有累积效应，且在推注剂量或连续输注给药后恢复迅速。
text_zh: 丙泊酚是一种短效、快速代谢的药物，其特征是几乎没有累积效应，且在推注剂量或连续输注给药后恢复迅速。
text_en: Propofol is a short-acting, rapidly metabolized drug characterized by virtually no cumulative effect and rapid recovery after bolus dosing or continuous infusion.

quote: It provides a reliable, rapid and smooth induction of anaesthesia, adequate hypnosis and analgesia for surgical interventions and minimal suppression of vital organ functions.
statement: 它提供可靠、快速和平稳的麻醉诱导，为手术干预提供足够的催眠和镇痛作用，并对重要器官功能的抑制最小。
text_zh: 它提供可靠、快速和平稳的麻醉诱导，为手术干预提供足够的催眠和镇痛作用，并对重要器官功能的抑制最小。
text_en: It provides reliable, rapid and smooth induction of anesthesia, sufficient hypnosis and analgesia for surgical intervention, and minimal depression of vital organ functions.
outcome: 麻醉诱导质量与器官功能保护

quote: Changes in hypothalamic concentration of neurotransmitters caused by cadmium may have adverse effects on various life processes as the hypothalamus participates in controlling and regulating body temperature, sexual and locomotor activity, hunger, and satiety (Romero et al. 2011).
statement: 由镉引起的下丘脑神经递质浓度的变化可能对各种生命过程产生不利影响，因为下丘参与控制和调节体温、性和运动活动、饥饿和饱腹感。
text_zh: 由镉引起的下丘脑神经递质浓度的变化可能对各种生命过程产生不利影响，因为下丘参与控制和调节体温、性和运动活动、饥饿和饱腹感。
text_en: Changes in hypothalamic neurotransmitter concentrations caused by cadmium may adversely affect various life processes, because the hypothalamus is involved in controlling and regulating body temperature, sexual and motor activity, hunger and satiety.

quote: The present study revealed a decrease in fish body weight along with exposure time in fish exposed to cadmium.
statement: 本研究表明，暴露于镉的鱼类的体重随暴露时间而下降。
text_zh: 本研究表明，暴露于镉的鱼类的体重随暴露时间而下降。
text_en: This study shows that the body weight of fish exposed to cadmium decreases with exposure time.

quote: In addition, we observed increased mortality in groups exposed to cadmium (Table 1).
statement: 此外，我们观察到暴露于镉的组别死亡率增加。
text_zh: 此外，我们观察到暴露于镉的组别死亡率增加。
text_en: In addition, we observed increased mortality in the groups exposed to cadmium.

quote: The inhibitory effect of cadmium on fish growth may be caused by disturbances in food intake and assimilation.
statement: 镉对鱼类生长的抑制作用可能是由食物摄入和同化的干扰引起的。
text_zh: 镉对鱼类生长的抑制作用可能是由食物摄入和同化的干扰引起的。
text_en: The inhibitory effect of cadmium on fish growth may be caused by interference with food intake and assimilation.

quote: The negative impact of cadmium on growth, body weight, and mortality has also been acknowledged by other authors (Szczerbik et al. 2006 ; Annabi et al. 2012 ; El-Serafy et al. 2013).
statement: 其他作者也承认镉对生长、体重和死亡率的负面影响。
text_zh: 其他作者也承认镉对生长、体重和死亡率的负面影响。
text_en: Other authors also acknowledge the negative effects of cadmium on growth, body weight and mortality.

quote: However, in gibel carp (Carassius auratus gibelio), the effect of FPR on hypoxia stress in HIF-1 signalling pathway and related NF-κB signalling pathway has not been reported yet.
statement: 在银鲫中，FPR对HIF-1信号通路及相关NF-κB信号通路低氧应激的影响尚未见报道。
text_zh: 在银鲫中，FPR对HIF-1信号通路及相关NF-κB信号通路低氧应激的影响尚未见报道。
text_en: In gibel carp, the effects of FPR on hypoxia stress in the HIF-1 signaling pathway and related NF-κB signaling pathways have not been reported.

quote: In previous studies of gibel carp, the hypoxia conditions could lead to some negative effects, such as inhibiting growth performance, inducing oxidative stress, and structural damage [ 34 , 35 ], which is one of the crucial limiting factors in aquaculture production of gibel carp.
statement: 先前的研究表明，低氧条件会导致银鲫生长性能抑制、氧化应激和结构损伤等负面影响，这是银鲫水产养殖生产中的关键限制因素之一。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，低氧条件会导致银鲫生长性能抑制、氧化应激和结构损伤等负面影响，这是银鲫水产养殖生产中的关键限制因素之一。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that hypoxia conditions lead to negative effects such as inhibited growth performance, oxidative stress, and structural damage in gibel carp, which is one of the key limiting factors in gibel carp aquaculture production.
outcome: 生长性能、氧化应激、结构损伤

quote: The study was to ascertain whether the incorporation of FPR into the diet could enhance the hypoxia tolerance by influencing these mechanisms.
statement: 本研究旨在确定日粮中添加FPR是否能够通过影响这些机制来增强低氧耐受性。
text_zh: 本研究旨在确定日粮中添加FPR是否能够通过影响这些机制来增强低氧耐受性。
text_en: This study aims to determine whether the incorporation of FPR into the diet can enhance hypoxia tolerance by affecting these mechanisms.

quote: In aquaculture, hypoxia stress can inhibit growth, immunocompetence, antioxidant, and metabolic patterns of cultured fish.
statement: 在水产养殖中，低氧胁迫会抑制养殖鱼类的生长、免疫能力、抗氧化能力和代谢模式。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，低氧胁迫会抑制养殖鱼类的生长、免疫能力、抗氧化能力和代谢模式。
text_en: In aquaculture, hypoxia stress inhibits the growth, immune capacity, antioxidant capacity, and metabolic patterns of farmed fish.
outcome: 生长、免疫、抗氧化及代谢健康

quote: In severe cases, this can lower survival rate (SR), which can lead to significant economic losses [ 6 , 7 ].
statement: 在严重情况下，低氧胁迫会降低存活率，从而导致重大的经济损失。
text_zh: 在严重情况下，低氧胁迫会降低存活率，从而导致重大的经济损失。
text_en: In severe cases, hypoxia stress reduces survival rates, leading to significant economic losses.

quote: A significant number of previous studies have found that the modulation of fish physiological processes by nutritional means can effectively improve their hypoxia tolerance [ 10 , 11 ].
statement: 大量先前研究发现，通过营养手段调节鱼类生理过程可以有效提高其耐低氧能力。
text_zh: 大量先前研究发现，通过营养手段调节鱼类生理过程可以有效提高其耐低氧能力。
text_en: A large number of previous studies have found that regulating physiological processes in fish through nutritional means can effectively improve their hypoxia tolerance.

quote: The addition of additives to diet is currently regarded as an effective means of enhancing hypoxia tolerance in aquatic animals [ 11 , 12 , 13 ].
statement: 目前认为在日粮中添加添加剂是增强水生动物耐低氧能力的有效手段。
text_zh: 目前认为在日粮中添加添加剂是增强水生动物耐低氧能力的有效手段。
text_en: Currently, adding additives to the diet is considered an effective means of enhancing the hypoxia tolerance of aquatic animals.

quote: The observations of stages 5-anesthesia onset were made using propofol and clove oil under the same experimental conditions.
statement: 在相同实验条件下，使用丙泊酚和丁香油观察了第5阶段麻醉的起始。
text_zh: 在相同实验条件下，使用丙泊酚和丁香油观察了第5阶段麻醉的起始。
text_en: Under the same experimental conditions, the onset of Stage 5 anesthesia was observed using propofol and clove oil.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉

quote: A 20- L experimental aquarium was maintained at a temperature of 22°C with oxygen saturation greater than 85%.
statement: 20升实验水族箱维持在22°C，氧饱和度大于85%。
text_zh: 20升实验水族箱维持在22°C，氧饱和度大于85%。
text_en: 20-liter experimental aquaria were maintained at 22°C, with oxygen saturation greater than 85%.

quote: Gold fish (n = 135) were randomly distributed into the experimental tank at the treatment concentrations of either 30 ppm clove oil (Valisek et al. 2005) and 7 ppm propofol .
statement: 金鱼被随机分配到含有30 ppm丁香油或7 ppm丙泊酚处理浓度的实验缸中。
text_zh: 金鱼被随机分配到含有30 ppm丁香油或7 ppm丙泊酚处理浓度的实验缸中。
text_en: Goldfish were randomly assigned to experimental tanks containing treatment concentrations of 30 ppm clove oil or 7 ppm propofol.
intervention_record: 丙泊酚与丁香油对比麻醉

quote: Once an individual fish had reached the onset of stage 5 anesthesia, a dip net was used to immediately remove it from the tank.
statement: 一旦个体鱼达到第5阶段麻醉起始，立即用抄网将其从缸中取出。
text_zh: 一旦个体鱼达到第5阶段麻醉起始，立即用抄网将其从缸中取出。
text_en: Once an individual fish reaches Stage 5 anesthesia onset, immediately remove it from the tank using a dip net.

quote: The fish was then transferred to a 20-L, well-oxygenated ‘recovery’ tank (i.e., no anesthesia present) maintained at 22°C and observed until it fully recovered.
statement: 随后将鱼转移到20升、充氧良好且无麻醉剂的‘恢复’缸中，维持22°C并观察直至完全恢复。
text_zh: 随后将鱼转移到20升、充氧良好且无麻醉剂的‘恢复’缸中，维持22°C并观察直至完全恢复。
text_en: The fish were then transferred to a 20-liter, well-oxygenated 'recovery' tank without anesthetic, maintained at 22°C and observed until full recovery.
outcome: 麻醉后恢复时间与状态

quote: During this recovery period, the fish behavior was observed and times to recovery were recorded.
statement: 在此期间，观察鱼的行为并记录恢复时间。
text_zh: 在此期间，观察鱼的行为并记录恢复时间。
text_en: During this period, observe the fish's behavior and record the recovery time.

quote: water tanks with a volume of 300 L for 12 h of hypoxia stress. The dissolved oxygen was reduced to a range of 0.6 ± 0.2 mg/L (Pen Dissolved Oxygen Metre, Dongguan Wanchuang Electronic Products Co., Ltd., Guangzhou, China) through the use of nitrogen aeration, and the water temperature was maintained in the range of 20.1 ± 0.6 °C (Thermometers, Shanghai Sundragon Electric Appliance Co., Ltd., Shanghai, China).
statement: 实验在300升水箱中通过氮气曝气将溶解氧降低至0.6 ± 0.2 mg/L，并维持水温在20.1 ± 0.6 °C，对鱼进行12小时的低氧胁迫。
text_zh: 实验在300升水箱中通过氮气曝气将溶解氧降低至0.6 ± 0.2 mg/L，并维持水温在20.1 ± 0.6 °C，对鱼进行12小时的低氧胁迫。
